name: Shattered Dimensions
detailed_description:
Shattered Dimensions – Psychological Horror Game

Step into the fractured reality of Shattered Dimensions, a psychological horror experience that blurs the line between nightmares and reality. Trapped in an ever-shifting environment, you must navigate a maze of distorted memories, cryptic messages, and unsettling entities that stalk your every move.

As you piece together fragments of a forgotten past, the world around you twists and reshapes itself, reacting to your fears and choices. Sounds echo from unseen corners, shadows move when you're not looking, and the deeper you explore, the more reality unravels.

Will you uncover the truth hidden within the fractures, or will you become lost in the darkness?

Prepare to question everything.

Who We Are - DomesticGoose Studio

We are DomesticGoose, an independent, self-published game developer based in İzmir/TÜRKİYE

At DomesticGoose Studios, we’re more than just a bunch of creatives trying to make a splash; we're a gaggle of honking rebels—feathers slightly ruffled, wings sometimes clipped, but always ready for flight. Our mission? To waddle fearlessly into uncharted waters, leaving ripples of clever chaos wherever we go.

Founded in a burst of caffeine-fueled inspiration (or possibly a breakdown), we exist to create work that makes people laugh, think, or at the very least, raise an eyebrow. We know that not everything in life is sunshine and rainbows (or even remotely understandable), so we embrace the absurdity and turn it into something worth your time—whether that’s a project, a partnership, or an epic piece of content.

If you’re looking for a team that takes pride in taking the piss out of convention, welcome. If you’re not… well, we’ll probably still make you laugh (or at least make you question your life choices).

DomesticGoose Studios: Because sometimes, the best ideas come from a honking mess.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mature content not suitable for all audiences. Players should be aware of the following elements:

Violence: Graphic depictions of blood, gore, and intense combat scenes
Horror Elements: Disturbing imagery, psychological horror, and jump scares
Mature Themes: The storyline deals with dark subject matter including death, trauma, and psychological distress
Language: Strong language and profanity throughout the game
Substance Use: Depictions of alcohol and drug consumption by characters
Sexual Content: Some scenes contain suggestive dialogue and references to sexual situations (no explicit sexual content is shown)
Player discretion is strongly advised. Not recommended for children or sensitive individuals.
